name: Pascal Arimont - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1755 as regards the amounts allocated to the Member States under the Brexit Adjustment Reserve
part_text:
The Brexit Adjustment Reserve was a €5.5 billion fund set up in 2021 to help countries deal with the effects of Brexit. Most of it has already been paid out or moved to other recovery funds. This report approves a cut of about €584 million to the reserve's remaining budget, matching a decision already taken when the European Union's long-term budget was revised in 2024. It is a technical budget adjustment and does not change what the reserve is for.

- The reserve's maximum budget is reduced by about €584 million; money already paid out or transferred is not affected.
- It affects European Union countries that receive money from the Brexit Adjustment Reserve.
- Parliament approves the change without amendments; the Commission can then update the final amounts each country gets.
